method: Each entry was produced while trying to anchor a claim: the quote could not be found, the author grepped for the truth, and the sentence was rewritten to match the source, then anchored to it.
note: Page paths are relative to the wiki root. Grouping is deliberately omitted: a heuristic classifier put 34 of 53 into an other bucket, and a false taxonomy is worse than none.

TRUE: scripts/git_gate.py's GATES list has 22 entries (ast.literal_eval count); .githooks/pre-push runs only `python3 "$ROOT/scripts/git_gate.py"`. Rewrote to 22 and stated plainly that 22 is a list length with no literal to quote.

quickstart.md: FALSE: the stale expectation lives at `scripts/check_openwiki.py:73`. TRUE: the literal `gcr_molecular_commits.json: protected_history=157 compensated=157 failed=0 schema=v0.2` is at line 76; line 73 is `"scripts/check_wiki_graph_sync.py",`. Removed the line number entirely and anchored the literal instead.

quickstart.md: FALSE: check_openwiki.py requires `openwiki/code-call-lifecycle.md` to contain the literal. TRUE: the REQUIRED_LITERALS key is `openwiki/nonofficial/code-call-lifecycle.md`. Corrected the path.

quickstart.md: UNDERSPECIFIED-BUT-TRUE: "Four gates read pages under `openwiki/`" checks out for gates actually in GATES (check_openwiki, check_wiki_graph_sync, check_lifecycle_datasets, check_autoresearch_lifecycle). check_prompt_trace_assets.py also reads an openwiki page but is NOT in GATES, so it is correctly excluded. Named the four explicitly so the count is now falsifiable.

nonofficial/autoresearch-composer-lifecycle.md: 'requires the two `cases.json` files to be identical' - check_autoresearch_lifecycle.py compares json.loads output (`if source_cases != repo_cases:`), not bytes, so reformatting either file still passes. Rewrote to 'parses both files and fails when the two parsed structures differ' and added the byte-vs-JSON caveat.

validation/ablation-and-benchmark.md: 'scripts/check_autoresearch_lifecycle.py re-runs the second row and requires all five of those values' - FALSE. The checker's reject condition is telemetry["case_count"] != 12 or telemetry["delta"] <= 0.05 or telemetry["verdict"] != "PASS" or telemetry.get("negative_case_count") != 6 or telemetry.get("negative_with_skill_success_rate") != 1.0. It never checks with_skill_success_rate, without_skill_success_rate or positive_case_count, and it accepts ANY delta above 0.05 rather than the measured 1.0. Rewrote the sentence to list the five real conditions and to say explicitly which table values are unchecked.

architecture/defense-gate-chain.md: '23 gates' in both the frontmatter description and the section heading - GATES in scripts/git_gate.py has 22 entries (20 before an inline comment block, 2 after); rewritten to 22.

architecture/defense-gate-chain.md: The gate list named validate_molecular_commit_lineage.py as a gate - the source comment states it 'is deliberately NOT gated here' because the repo has no .git of its own and the no-argument path is 'a schema check that never walks history at all'; removed from the list and replaced with an anchored paragraph on the exclusion plus the out-of-chain --repo-root invocation.

architecture/overview.md: '23 of them sequenced by scripts/git_gate.py' - the GATES list has 22 entries (ast.literal_eval on git_gate.py); a 9-line comment block inside the list literal makes eye-counting give 23
architecture/overview.md: 'scripts/check_openwiki.py is itself one of the 23 gates' - same error, it is one of 22

architecture/overview.md: '30 scripts' sequenced/present - there are exactly 30 .py files plus one .sh (test_plan_package_compat.sh) under scripts/; narrowed the wording to '30 Python scripts under scripts/'

architecture/overview.md: 'skills/<slug>/... plus a status.json promotion decision. Two slugs today: gemini_interactions (quarantined) and autoresearch_composer (production-seed-candidate)' - skills/autoresearch_composer/ contains only cases.json, references/, skills.md; it has NO status.json. Its status string lives in data/lifecycle/skill_optimization_registry.json as "current_status": "production-seed-candidate" and is enforced by scripts/check_lifecycle_datasets.py. governance/plan-package-compatibility.md: Claimed plan-package.compat.yaml records `final_repo_small_loop_policy: forbidden`. Truth: that key does not appear in plan-package.compat.yaml at all; it appears in .plan-package.lock.yaml and in openwiki/nonofficial/openwiki.yaml.

governance/plan-package-compatibility.md: Claimed the policy key lives in `openwiki/openwiki.yaml`. Truth: no such file exists; the path is openwiki/nonofficial/openwiki.yaml, which scripts/check_openwiki.py pins as a REQUIRED_LITERALS entry.

governance/plan-package-compatibility.md: Implied all six listed counts are pinned by the gate. Truth: check_plan_package_compat.py compares only project_template_file_count, molecular_commit_count, lineage_edge_count and plan_package_input_count; governance_template_count and shadow_defense_count are never read.

lifecycle/structured-datasets.md: 'Seven fields, each pinned' for the eval-run result_summary - expected_summary in scripts/check_lifecycle_datasets.py has EIGHT keys (pr_cases, pr_passed, nightly_cases, nightly_passed, trace_samples, failure_trace_samples, ablation_delta, status), and the page's own code block already listed all eight. lifecycle/structured-datasets.md: 'Six keys must be present, and four of them are cross-checked' - the gate checks the VALUE of all six human_admit_binding keys, not four: dataset_versions and molecular_commit against the promotion record's own fields, and plan_package_input_ids / route / routes_edge_id / lineage_edge_id against constants in the script. Rewritten to say all six are value-checked, two against the record and four against constants (which is also what the page's own six-row table already showed).

nonofficial/asset-lifecycle-map.md: "yields delta=0.50" was incomplete: running the script prints "delta=0.50 case_count=10" for the default gemini_interactions dataset, not the case_count=12 the paired autoresearch_composer example implies. nonofficial/code-call-lifecycle.md: "the 23 entries of GATES" / "one of those 23 gates" / mermaid "23 registered gates" - ast.literal_eval of GATES in scripts/git_gate.py returns 22 entries; all three occurrences corrected to 22 and noted as a list length.

nonofficial/code-call-lifecycle.md: "scripts/check_openwiki.py:73 still expects..." - the protected_history=157 literal is at line 76 (line 73 is a different REQUIRED_LITERALS entry); rewritten to name the REQUIRED_LITERALS entry with no line number, twice.

nonofficial/prompt-trace-assets.md: Wiki said `data/lifecycle/trace_privacy_classification.json` classifies each dataset and that the prompt traces are classified there. TRUE FACT: that ledger's `datasets` array lists only data/autoresearch_traces/local_trace_samples.jsonl and failure_trace_samples.jsonl (classification synthetic-local / synthetic-local-failure) with default_policy local-only-until-human-admit; the `local-structured-prompt-metadata` classification and `terms_guard` live in prompt_trace_dataset.json's own privacy_policy. nonofficial/prompt-trace-assets.md: Wiki said check_prompt_trace_assets.py 'requires every record to fill REQUIRED_SLOTS'. TRUE FACT: it requires exactly 3 records and compares the SET of their `prompt_slot` values against REQUIRED_SLOTS (len(records) != 3, then slots != REQUIRED_SLOTS) — one record per slot. Sentence rewritten and anchored to the constant.

nonofficial/README.md: "This page is ... the entry named by openwiki.yaml (openwiki_entry)" — FALSE. scripts/check_openwiki.py pins `openwiki_entry: openwiki/quickstart.md`; this page is merely a REQUIRED_FILES entry whose eight literal section names are greped. nonofficial/README.md: Path `openwiki/openwiki.yaml` — FALSE, one directory level missing. The real path in check_openwiki.py REQUIRED_FILES is `openwiki/nonofficial/openwiki.yaml`. Rewrote to name the real path and call out the difference.

nonofficial/README.md: "the skills.md / cases.json / references/ shape ... the baseline scripts/validator.py enforces" — FALSE scope. validator.py only globs `skills/*/cases.json` and checks case fields, 10-20 count, 5+/5+ polarity and near-duplicate prompts; it never reads skills.md or references/. skills.md structure is enforced by scripts/validate_progressive_disclosure.py. nonofficial/stateful-workflow.md: The page drew three conditional edges as if all were repo concepts; grep over skills/, scripts/, data/, tests/ finds only conditional_edge.S7.openwiki_fail (in check_openwiki.py). S5.baseline_fail and S6.delta_below_target appear nowhere in the source. Added the true qualifier in S7 with the anchor.

validation/synthetic-corpus-quality.md: FALSE: '`interactions_patch_assert_runner.py` proves the generator and the matcher agree with each other.' TRUE: the runner never reads the generator's `expected_checks` (the string does not occur in the file); it matches against its own module-level `RULES` table, and `patched_agent(_prompt, language)` discards the prompt and returns one of two constant strings. All 117 cases reduce to two fixed snippets checked against two fixed rule sets - it does not exercise the generator's assertions at all.
